AlreadyDeployed().details: The given address has already deployed a stash.

AlreadyOnCurrentVersion().details: The Stash is attempting to upgrade to a version it is already on.

InvalidVersion(uint256,uint256).details: Contract owner is attempting to add a version, but the implementation's version() function does not match.

NewOwnerIsZeroAddress().details: The `newOwner` cannot be the zero address.

NoHandoverRequest().details: The `pendingOwner` does not have a valid handover request.

StashAddressMismatch().details: The deployed Stash address does not match the predicted address.

Unauthorized().details: The caller is not authorized to call the function.

AuctionSet(address,bool).details: Emitted when an auction is marked as valid or invalid.

OwnershipHandoverCanceled(address).details: The ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been canceled.

OwnershipHandoverRequested(address).details: An ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been requested.

OwnershipTransferred(address,address).details: The ownership is transferred from `oldOwner` to `newOwner`. This event is intentionally kept the same as OpenZeppelin's Ownable to be compatible with indexers and [EIP-173](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-173), despite it not being as lightweight as a single argument event.

RolesUpdated(address,uint256).details: The `user`'s roles is updated to `roles`. Each bit of `roles` represents whether the role is set.

Upgraded(address,address).details: The implementation for a proxy has been upgraded.

VersionAdded(uint256,address).details: Emitted when a new version of the Stash implementation is added.

params.implementation: Address of new implementation. Version number is read from the implementation and must match next version.

cancelOwnershipHandover().details: Cancels the two-step ownership handover to the caller, if any.

completeOwnershipHandover(address).details: Allows the owner to complete the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`. Reverts if there is no existing ownership handover requested by `pendingOwner`.

deployStash(address).details: Deploys a new Stash contract using the current implementation. Any caller can deploy a stash for any owner. for example, a mint contract can deploy a stash for a user as a part of the mint transaction.

params._owner: The owner of the new Stash contract.

returns.deployedAddress: The address of the newly deployed Stash contract.

grantRoles(address,uint256).details: Allows the owner to grant `user` `roles`. If the `user` already has a role, then it will be an no-op for the role.

owner().details: Returns the owner of the contract.

ownerHasDeployed(address).details: This function is meant for convenience. It uses extcodesize to check if a contract has been deployed to the predicted address. It is not a perfect check, and will return false if called from within a constructor of a Stash.

ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(address).details: Returns the expiry timestamp for the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`.

renounceOwnership().details: Allows the owner to renounce their ownership.

renounceRoles(uint256).details: Allow the caller to remove their own roles. If the caller does not have a role, then it will be an no-op for the role.

requestOwnershipHandover().details: Request a two-step ownership handover to the caller. The request will automatically expire in 48 hours (172800 seconds) by default.

revokeRoles(address,uint256).details: Allows the owner to remove `user` `roles`. If the `user` does not have a role, then it will be an no-op for the role.

setAuction(address,bool).details: Stash contracts can only submit bids on valid auctions.

params._isAuction: Whether or not the auction is valid.
params.auction: The address of the auction to flag.

params.stashOwner: The owner of the Stash contract

returns._0: stash The address of the Stash contract

transferOwnership(address).details: Allows the owner to transfer the ownership to `newOwner`.

upgradeStash().details: Upgrades a Stash contract to the latest version. Only callable by Stash owner. Reverts if already on the latest version

_AUCTION_MANAGER_ROLE.details: The role that can mark auctions as valid or invalid

_STASH_VERIFIER.details: StashVerifier is used as a passthrough to read from the Stash implementation since StashFactory cannot call the Stash directly

_VERSION_MANAGER_ROLE.details: The role that can add new versions of the Stash implementation

auctions.details: a mapping of auction addresses to whether or not they have been marked as valid

currentVersion.details: the current version of the Stash implementation.

implementations.details: a mapping of Stash version numbers to Stash implementation addresses

addVersion(address).notice: Adds a new version of the Stash implementation. Any newly deployed stashs will use the most recent version.

constructor.notice: Deploys the first version of the Stash implementation and sets the owner to the deployer.

deployStash(address).notice: Deploys a new Stash contract using the current implementation, and returns the address.

isAuction(address).notice: Returns whether or not an auction is valid.

isStash(address).notice: Returns whether or not a stash is valid from the perspective of the auction manager this requires a separate passthrough contract because calling the stash storage contract from within the auction manager will not delegate the call to the implementation.

ownerHasDeployed(address).notice: Returns whether or not a stash has been deployed for a given owner.

setAuction(address,bool).notice: Flags an auction as valid or invalid.

stashAddressFor(address).notice: Returns the address of the Stash contract for a given owner, regardless of whether or not it has been deployed yet.

upgradeStash().notice: Upgrades a Stash contract to the latest version.

userdoc.notice: Factory contract for deploying and upgrading Stash contracts.
